scope: first8 fixed training-source BANKING77 cases; exposure unknown

protocol.timing: prefix build excluded; fresh cache copying included; ordinary only
protocol.memory_observer: own-PID RSS via ps; separate memory cycle; profile LAST
protocol.resource_gate: all three pairs reduction >= max(64MiB,5% retained sampled peak), plus lower observed selected live KV storage
protocol.promotion: none; ordinary timings descriptive; failed/missing sampling unsupported
protocol.common_path_change: both use_cache=False; same private owner kept through head; only cache lifetime differs
